profile.headline: AI Solutions Architect | Full Stack Developer | Team Lead | SCRUM Master
profile.summary: Versatile and experienced technology professional with a proven track record across software engineering, product design, team leadership, and Agile project delivery. Adept at driving cross-functional initiatives from concept through deployment, with a focus on building scalable systems, elevating user experience, and enabling team velocity. Skilled at bridging technical execution with stakeholder collaboration, consistently contributing to high-impact outcomes across full-stack development, UX/UI strategy, quality assurance, and agile frameworks.

positions.title: AI Solutions Architect
positions.description: CivicPlus is a US based govtech company that is a leading provider of technology solutions for local government, serving over 12,000 customers and impacting over 340 million community members in the United States and Canada. I am currently the AI Solutions Architect for their internal AI team, focusing on building AI centered solutions while enabling team members to experiment, learn, and build with their own AI solutions.

positions.title: System Architect Team Lead
positions.description: CastleRock ITS was a government contracting company focused on traffic, ATMS, and 511 systems for several states and municipalities in the United States. The company specialized in giving public access to traffic information through phone, web, and apps. In my time with the company, I lead initiatives in rebuilding their entire front end 511 platform, focusing on a single codebase supporting web, iOS, and Android.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer III
positions.description: Meta (formerly named Facebook) is an American multinational technology conglomerate based in Menlo Park, California. The company owns and operates Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp, among other products and services and ranks among the largest American information technology companies. I worked with the network infrastructure team in developing solutions for managing and implementing fiber optic networks throughout the world.

positions.title: System Architect
positions.description: Prime Occupational Medicine consists of a chain of over 15 clinical locations through the southern United States, focused on providing occupational health, screening, and clinical needs. In my role with the company, I helped lead a team of 6 developers, QA, and support, in the maintenance of a legacy .NET system during the transition to a greenfield rework of their patient management platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Red Hat, Inc. is an multinational software company providing open-source software products to the enterprise community.  I acted as a senior developer and team lead in various supporting roles for RedHat.com, including both designing and developing for the site.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Postly was founded in 2015 as a social media platform focused on content-driven, private communication.  Postly's major focus has been on the mobile sharing side, with a Android and iOS application, with limited support for a web-based application.  I specialized as the mobile application and front end architect for the project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: AxS Health is a start-up company in the digital health arena, aimed at easing the on-boarding and telemedicine process for practices.  Offering EHR integrations or practice specific workflows, AxS has been in business for the past 4 years with several practices utilizing the application suite.  As one of the two software engineers on the project, I specialized as a full stack developer, supporting the PHP backend, the web-based provider application, and mobile client application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Vail Resorts owns and runs over 10 mountain resorts nationally and 2 major international resorts.  They are a major player in the travel and recreation industries, primarily focused on ski and snowboard destinations.  I have worked on several major projects with Vail, including a redesign of their careers website, a redesign of all ten major mountain sites, as well as working with their native iOS / Android app.  During my time here, we have had several major releases, including EpicMix Time, which prompted Fast Company to rate Vail Resorts as one of the top 50 most innovative companies.  My primary focus has been front-end web development, but I have also contributed to .NET, iOS, and Android code bases.

positions.title: UI / UX Developer
positions.description: Data Connect is a versatile company that primarily specializes in trade-show and event registration and marketing, with several other product lines revolving around .NET and web technologies.  I specialized as the primary UI / UX developer, creating web based front ends for various aspects of the business, while building and maintaining marketing sites for various events and shows.  While at Data Connect, I also developed the company's first iPad app, built for show registration.  I have used various technologies while employed at Data Connect, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Objective C.

positions.title: Owner / Operator
positions.description: Better IT Solutions was an Information Technology support company aimed at providing high-level support for small and growing businesses.  I started the company in 2010 and developed great relationships with both professional and individual clients.  My aim was to help companies accomplish their goals through technology, with specialization in solutions for business as well as client facing advertising through web and social media.

positions.title: Web Design / Development
positions.description: Contracted for user inteface and user experience design for their client portal. Browser compatability (through IE7), AJAX calls, and backend integration were required for the project. The team also utilized SCRUM meetings using an AGILE workflow system.

projects.title: Vail Resorts Redesign
projects.description: During my time at Vail Resorts, I contributed to the full front-end redesign of Vail's mountain sites.  During this project, I helped architect, manage, scope, and develop, with contributions both to the front end systems and the back end supporting structure.

projects.title: Ready Funds Client Prortal
projects.description: During a conversion to a new system, Ready Funds needed to implement a new system for clients to manage and view their accounts.  I was contracted for the client-facing portion of the project, which involved developing and designing the client facing user interface.  HTML, CSS, LESS, BootStrap, JavaScript, JSON, AJAX calls, jQuery, and back-end integration were required for the project.
